notes.title: Demo Rework/Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
Attention Divers!
We're excited to roll out an update that revamps the demo and provides a number of improvements to the game.

New Features

"Messages" tab is now available in the demo! Use it to review all transmissions sent by the Operator and view a list of all tutorial guides you've found.
Additional Options added

Improvements

Improved translation overlay for Close-Ups
Some objects in "The Day After" were moved to easier to find and logical places
New models and textures for giant roots in the Mind Ocean
New swim animation
New Intro animation
New visuals for Subconscious Gate labels
Brushed up the visuals of the multitool
Slightly improved placements of tutorial prompts
Improved UI scaling for various resolutions and aspect ratios
Many bug fixes
Vastly improved optimizations (Demo is now 1.7 GB smaller than before, among other things!)

Important Disclaimer:
Please note that save files created in previous versions will not carry over. We’ve made several updates to the save system, which means that saves from older demo versions are no longer compatible with the latest version.

We truly appreciate everyone's support and we hear all of your feedback! 
We are currently working closely with the developer to try and polish the build as much as possible in preparation for release! Stay tuned for more updates!

If you have any feedback or bugs to report, please post them on the forum(s):
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2259330/discussions/

notes.title: Demo Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
Thank you all for playing Mind Diver!

After hearing your feedback and bug reports, we have rolled out a patch which fixes several bugs that were affecting the playability of the game.

Improved swimming

More fine-grained control to better be able to adjust course. Especially useful when having to go through narrow passageways.
Reworked the boost system so that the player no longer has to time it correctly. The boost now simply charges up and can be used at any time. There is no "penalty" for missing a timing.
Larger floor colliders on memories, so that players do not fall down when leaving a memory. 

Bug Fixes / Changes

Coloured subtitles to help with distinguishing characters speaking.  Also in transcripts to make the reading experience of transcripts more clear.
Improved environmental guidance towards "The Day After" from "Party: Welcome", and hid the party memories when players are outside to avoid misleading.
Fixed an issue with not being able to select a transcript if the echo is currently playing.
Fixed the echo highlight effect sometimes not appearing.
Optimization, especially for faster loading times.
Audio for listening part of the multitool changed to be more discreet.
Adjustments to make the arms/tools switching avoid overlapping to avoid having three arms.
Various minor fixes to colliders.
Replaced the survey button with a Discord button to capture more feedback from Steam Next Fest.

We truly appreciate everyone's support and we hear all of your feedback! We are currently working closely with the developer to try and squash more bugs and implement more QoL features! Stay tuned for more updates!

If you have any feedback or bugs to report, please post them on the forum(s):
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2259330/discussions/

notes.title: Mind Diver to be Released in 2025!
notes.content:
PLAYISM is proud to announce that we will be publishing Mind Diver, the mystery adventure by Indoor Sunglasses, and that the game is slated for a Steam release in 2025!

Here's a new trailer that introduces more of the game. Please give it a watch!

[previewyoutube=3slLnnozOoM;full][/previewyoutube]
You are a Mind Diver. Explore the Mind Ocean to solve a twisted case.

Please add the game to your wishlist and look forward to further announcements!

What's more, Mind Diver will have a playable demo to be shown at PAX East in Boston from May 8 to May 11. We'll also be giving out free flyers of the game to anyone who plays the demo at the PLAYISM booth, so please stop by if you have the chance!
